summary: Phase 2 Ticket/Help system fully tested (backend + frontend). 11/11 pytest cases pass covering create/list/access-control/staff-only/auto-assign/claim/status flows. Frontend UI verified for regular user, staff (collaborator), and unauthorized third-party user: nav-tickets link, role-aware Tickets page (Meus tickets vs Help Center with tabs + stat cards), TicketDetail (status badge, reply, claim/resolve/reopen), and the btn-ask-human dialog on ProjectDetail creating a ticket and navigating to /tickets/:id. No functional bugs found in Phase 2.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 760 lines; approaching the 700-line threshold — consider splitting Tickets, Admin, Projects into separate routers for maintainability.

GET /tickets/mine is defined AFTER the parameterized /tickets/{tid} route in narrative but Python order in file is correct (line 540 before 564) so no shadowing — good. Keep an eye on this when adding new routes.

create_ticket silently ignores an invalid project_id/step_id (project_name/step_title just stay null). Consider returning 404 when a non-owned project_id is supplied instead of silently accepting to avoid client confusion.
list_tickets has no pagination (500 hard cap) and no filter combination for owner+status; fine for MVP but will need pagination as tickets grow.
TicketDetail.jsx: send() and setStatus() calls have no explicit error handling on 403/404 beyond a generic toast; acceptable but consider surfacing server error detail.
